name: Revise
description:
Revise is a collaborative word processor built for working with AI agents. This connector lets Claude interact with documents in your Revise account, where you and Claude can collaborate in real-time.

Ask Claude to draft, import, edit, and export documents directly in Revise, including .docx and .pdf support. Every AI change appears in Revise’s red/green revision system, so you can review and accept or reject edits.

Claude can list, search, read, edit, rename, format, and share documents across your Revise account. It can even check which documents you already have open, to more easily join you in what you're doing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Revise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Revise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.revise.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Revise MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Revise lists 18 MCP tools, including create_document, delete_document, edit_document, export_document, get_document_info, get_document_outline, get_recent_changes, import_document, invite_collaborator, list_documents, list_open_documents, and read_document.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Revise?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Revise in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Revise requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Revise is developed by Migraine, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
